Abstract: Author(s): Mandun Fu, Ian Farrer, David A. Ritchie, and Sanjeev Kumar The authors show here how electrostatic coupling and spin physics reshape the 7/3 fractional quantum Hall state in an uncoupled GaAs bilayer system. Gate tuning balances an incompressible integer state ( ν =1) and a fragile fractional composite-fermion state ( ν =4/3), producing a double-minimum structure in longitudinal resistance within a single 7/3 Hall plateau.
